adopted: 10/11/11bitの安定LSD3パス。カウンタはIndex型。uint32_t経路は点数<=UINT32_MAXを既存dispatcherで保証し、他はsize_t。

conditions.cpu: Intel i9-14900K、root CPU14最大6GHz、agent CPU16最大4.4GHz。コア別lock、rootは共通benchmark lockも使用。並行する別コア作業あり。
conditions.target: GCC -march=nativeと-march=znver2。後者はZen2向け生成コードの補足比較で、実行CPUはIntelのまま。現在のLC機体・生成コードとの同一性を保証しない。
conditions.official: 同じmain/FastIO/検査省略設定、GCC -std=c++23 -O2。29保存入力×2target×3候補、7反復を順序回転、process起動を含むperf_counter壁時計中央値。stdoutは/dev/null。
conditions.synthetic: 同じbench.cpp。入力生成/presortは計測外。コピー/確保/整列/solve/解放/checksumが計測内。21条件×3構成×5反復。unsized補足はpublicAPIで30条件×7反復。
conditions.limitations: 公式大規模で約1～12%短縮、格子系約1～3%。小規模の一部とClang4096点unsizedで約3%後退。全入力・全CPUで無退行を保証しない。固定カウンタ作業領域は旧版8KiBから24KiB(Index32)/48KiB(Index64)へ増加。

agent_summary.scope: Initial stablexradix uses10/11/11bits instead4x8; histogram counter typeIndex, uint32 only alreadybounded case, size_t fallback.
agent_summary.conditions: Intel14900K CPU16 fixed withperCPUlock, compilerCPU6; GCC15.2 O2 -march=znver2(requestedapproximation, notjudgehardware), GCCnative, Clang21 O2 baseline. Five roundrobin reps, inputs generated outside timer; copy/allocation/radix/solve/free/checksum inside. Othercores mayrunconcurrently.
agent_summary.recommendation: Radix10 candidate promising forparentofficial/Pcorevalidation. GCClarge random/grid~4–5%,clusters6–7%,horizontal12–13%faster; Clanglarge mostlysame or4–10%faster. No large >1.5%retreat in21case matrix. Radix11 slightlybetterhorizontal but weakergrid. countIndexalone tiny mixedgains.
agent_summary.counter_proof: Every count/prefixsum/postincrementoffset ≤N. Publicuint32wrapper selectsN≤UINT32_MAX; atmaxN lastindexN−1 andfinaloffsetN fit. Otherinputranges retain size_t. No newruntimevalidation scan.
agent_summary.sort_proof: StableLSD scatters coverkeybits0..9,10..20,21..31 ofsignflippedint32x. Unusedpaddedbuckets stayzero. Eachvalidpass fillsalloutputindices exactlyonce, skipinactivepass preservesinput and bufferinitialization invariant. Thus same stablexsequence asold4pass and oldclosestpairbehavior.

wide_unsized_performance.actual_path: constP* Iterator and ==onlyUnsizedEnd, static_asserts sentinel_for and !sized_sentinel_for. Thus Index=size_t and48KiBhist, no reserve length.
wide_unsized_performance.decision: No materiallargewide regression observed, so no type-dependent4passfallback needed.

decisions.count_index_only: 4パスのままカウンタ型だけを変える案は利益が小さい。
decisions.radix11: 11/11/10bitはCPU14公式で10/11/11より速い箇所があるが、CPU16の大規模格子・クラスタ等は10/11/11のほうが改善が大きい。複数条件のバランスから10/11/11を選択。
decisions.radix10: vectorだけでなくsize_t添字のunsized経路でも大規模の改善を確認。幅の動的分岐を増やさず全経路に採用。
decisions.simd: 新規追加なし。既存のSIMD候補は他条件の退行を解消できておらず、今回の改善は走査回数の削減。

from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent;s=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env/Geometry/Nearest_Two_points.cpp').read_text();(p/'baseline.hpp').write_text(s)
v=s.replace('std::array<std::array<std::size_t, 256>, 4> counts{};','std::array<std::array<Index, 256>, 4> counts{};').replace('std::size_t sum = 0;\n            for (auto& count : offsets)','Index sum = 0;\n            for (auto& count : offsets)');(p/'count_index.hpp').write_text(v)
v=v.replace('std::array<std::array<Index, 256>, 4> counts{};','std::array<std::array<Index, 2048>, 3> counts{};')
v=v.replace('for (unsigned pass = 0; pass < 4; ++pass) ++counts[pass][(key >> (pass * 8)) & 255U];','++counts[0][key & 2047U];\n            ++counts[1][(key >> 11) & 2047U];\n            ++counts[2][key >> 22];')
v=v.replace('for (unsigned pass = 0; pass < 4; ++pass) {','for (unsigned pass = 0; pass < 3; ++pass) {').replace('offsets[(key >> (pass * 8)) & 255U]++','offsets[(key >> (pass * 11)) & 2047U]++');(p/'radix11.hpp').write_text(v)
# Three 10/11/11-bit passes; vary firstbucket width while keeping samehist storage.
v=v.replace('++counts[0][key & 2047U];\n            ++counts[1][(key >> 11) & 2047U];\n            ++counts[2][key >> 22];','++counts[0][key & 1023U];\n            ++counts[1][(key >> 10) & 2047U];\n            ++counts[2][key >> 21];').replace('offsets[(key >> (pass * 11)) & 2047U]++','offsets[(key >> (pass == 0 ? 0 : pass == 1 ? 10 : 21)) & (pass == 0 ? 1023U : 2047U)]++');(p/'radix10.hpp').write_text(v)
(p/'bench.cpp').write_bytes(Path('/tmp/sirkit_nearest_finalscan_20261024/bench.cpp').read_bytes())
